newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: U.S.Economy working close to capacity - McDonough.
newsitem.headline: U.S.Economy working close to capacity - McDonough.

text.p: The U.S. economy is operating fairly close to full capacity, Federal Reserve Bank of New York President William McDonough said in Dublin on Tuesday night.
But he said that it was clear that looking at prices the economy was not operating above capacity.
"My own view is that we are operating about at capacity level," he said after a speech to the Society of Investment Analysts in Ireland.
